advisory_headline.tr: Monako dünyanın en güvenli şehir devletidir; yoğun güvenlik kamerası ağı ve polis mevcudiyeti bulunur.
advisory_headline.en: Monaco boasts one of the lowest crime rates globally with pervasive 24/7 video surveillance.
advisory_headline.de: Monaco verzeichnet eine der niedrigsten Kriminalitätsraten weltweit mit lückenloser Videoüberwachung.
advisory_headline.ru: Монако — одно из самых безопасных государств в мире с круглосуточным видеонаблюдением.
advisory_headline.es: Mónaco cuenta con uno de los índices de criminalidad más bajos del mundo y videovigilancia integral.

local_apps.name: Uber

tr.conditions: Monako ile Fransa arasında sınır kontrolü yoktur; Fransa ve Schengen vize kuralları birebir geçerlidir. Türk umuma mahsus pasaport hamilleri Schengen vizesine tabidir (Yeşil pasaporta vizesiz).

us.conditions: US citizens enter Monaco visa-free under standard Schengen 90/180-day regulations via France.

de.conditions: German and EU citizens enter Monaco freely with an EU national ID card or passport via France.

gb.conditions: British passport holders can visit Monaco and the Schengen area visa-free for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.

ru.conditions: Гражданам РФ для посещения Монако требуется действующая шенгенская виза категории C.

dos.title: Use public public elevators and escalators
dos.description: Monaco is built on steep cliffs; dozens of free public elevators and covered moving walkways connect the port to upper streets.

dos.title: Dress smartly for the Casino de Monte-Carlo
dos.description: Smart attire is strictly enforced in the gaming rooms; flip-flops, sportswear, and shorts are not allowed in the evening.

dos.title: Wear shoes and a shirt on city streets
dos.description: Walking shirtless or barefoot outside beach areas is illegal in Monaco and subject to police intervention.

donts.title: Don't pick up street passengers in foreign taxis
donts.description: Only official Monaco-registered red-and-white taxis are permitted to pick up passengers within the Principality.

donts.title: Don't overlook roaming charges
donts.description: Check if your carrier includes Monaco in your EU roaming plan; some operators treat Monaco as high-cost non-EU territory.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 10-15% is customary in fine dining establishments in Monte Carlo for attentive white-glove service.
